notes.title: The Elementalist Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h2]About[/h2]
The Demo Update is here, and it features a few things I wanted it to have, but didn't have time to include in the first version. The most important new feature is the undo button, which makes the game a lot nicer to play. The update also features a bunch of level design reworks and adjustments.

This should be the only update of the demo, unless there are any problems that need to be fixed.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Introduced the undo button (bound to "Z" by default).[/b]
[*]Fixed a plenty of bugs (the ones related to the fire ability were the most annoying).
[*]Reworked the dialog system, also the dialog card has a portrait (it's only the sign for now lol).
[*]Made a basic speedrun timer, you can turn it on in the options menu.
[*]Level name is displayed when standing next to a level portal. World info card shows up when standing next to a world portal.
[*]Reworked a few levels.
[*]Adjusted a [b]lot[/b] of levels.
[*]Adjusted Zoe's animations a tiny bit.
[*]Other minor stuff that I don't remember right now.
[/list]

By the way, the update wasn't supposed to go live today, but I've accidentally published it, whoops

notes.title: Elementalist development progress 16.09.2024
notes.notes:
After releasing the demo, I began to create more content for the game, here's what I made so far.

Join my discord if you want to be constantly updated on the development, or just hang out: https://discord.com/invite/Fh84dZVpR4


New stuff:
[list]
[*] The undo system (very cool and useful)
[*] Love (the 5th element), makes Zoe (the player) do a little kiss, resetting her velocity. The ability is mostly used in combination with other entities.
[*] Reverse orb (reverses the order of your elemental stack upon collecting)
[*] Order gate (opens when you execute abilities displayed on it in correct order)
[*] Minus orb (removes the top element from your element stack)
[*] World 4 - Amor Operatorium. It explores reverse orbs, and order gates (will also explore the minus orb in the future).
[*] World 5 - Amor Knipe. It will explore the Love element (and only that for now, it's very early in development).
[*] Level name is displayed when standing next to a level portal. World info card shows up when standing next to a world portal.
[*] Trying to improve the animations, but very minor changes for now.
[*] Fine-tuning some of the older levels to make them less cringe.
[*] Bug fixes (yay)
[/list]

Watch this video to see the stuff listed here in action!

[previewyoutube=aRT3x3BbKOs;full][/previewyoutube]

I may update the demo in the future, so it features the undo system. I was also thinking about taking part in GDWC, which would be a perfect opportunity to update the demo. Other than that, I want to make an actual dialog and cutscene system next, but the development will slow down due to me doing my masters.
